title: Monthly Report
overallCumulativeNote: * Overall Cumulative = Annual Cumulative + prior years' actuals. It looks the same as Annual Cumulative until you enter "Prior-Year Cumulative" in the Data Entry tab.
statusRuleProgressGreen: Overall progress is on track against the project plan
statusRuleProgressYellow: Cumulative progress is on track, but this month's progress is behind plan
statusRuleProgressRed: Overall progress is behind the project plan
statusRuleRevenueGreen: Annual revenue (Jan–current) is on track against plan
statusRuleRevenueYellow: Annual cumulative revenue is on track, but this month's revenue is behind plan
statusRuleCostGreen: Cumulative cost execution is on track against plan (within 2% difference)
statusRuleCostYellow: Some cost items deviate from plan (a few items within 2%–5%)
statusRuleCostRed: Cost deviation needs attention (some items exceed 5%)
statusRuleFundsRed: Receivables need attention ($1 Mil. or more)
fundsSyncNote: * Same as the Management Dashboard's cash flow (including the detail view)
fundsDetailNote: * The detail view table adds revenue, confirmed amount, and collection receivable
